article_title: I got paid $5,000 to move to a place I'd never heard of

tasks.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: Why remote workers are returning to expensive coastal cities
How relocation incentives and lower costs are attracting people to smaller US communities
Why small US cities are banning new residents
How families can earn money by selling their homes
tasks.correct_answer: How relocation incentives and lower costs are attracting people to smaller US communities
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מתארת תוכניות שמציעות כסף והטבות למעבר לערים קטנות, ואת השיפור הכלכלי לצד החסרונות.

tasks.prompt: How did Brianna Beyrouti's monthly housing costs change after moving to Muncie?
options: They rose from $1,100 to $1,290
Her combined mortgage, insurance and tax became $1,100, below her former $1,290 rent
They stayed at exactly $1,290
She received a free home with no monthly costs
tasks.correct_answer: Her combined mortgage, insurance and tax became $1,100, below her former $1,290 rent
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בפורטלנד שילמה 1,290 דולר שכירות; במנסי המשכנתה, הביטוח ומס הנכס יחד הם 1,100 דולר.

tasks.prompt: What does Brianna mean when she says she had been financially “drowning”?
options: She was paying for frequent water damage
She wanted to live near the sea
She was struggling badly to meet everyday expenses
Her bank had stopped paying her salary
tasks.correct_answer: She was struggling badly to meet everyday expenses
tasks.explanation_hebrew: drowning משמש כאן כדימוי למצוקה כלכלית קשה וחיים ממשכורת למשכורת.

tasks.prompt: What does Muncie offer eligible remote workers from outside Indiana?
options: A guaranteed job at a local university
A detached house at no cost
A permanent exemption from income tax
$5,000 towards relocation costs
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המועצה המקומית מציעה 5,000 דולר לכיסוי עלויות המעבר כדי למשוך עובדים מרחוק ולהגדיל אוכלוסייה.

tasks.prompt: Why has remote work helped relocation programmes in smaller cities?
options: People can keep jobs and salaries while living in cheaper places
Employers require all workers to move to rural towns
Remote workers receive free property everywhere
It removes every social disadvantage of moving
tasks.correct_answer: People can keep jobs and salaries while living in cheaper places
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בריאנה המשיכה לעבוד עבור אותו בנק ובאותו שכר, אך נהנתה מעלויות נמוכות יותר במקום החדש.

tasks.prompt: What does the JREDC mean when it says its package helps “sweeten the deal”?
options: It provides free food for every resident
It makes the offer more attractive through extra benefits
It guarantees that housing prices will fall
It replaces cash with restaurant vouchers
tasks.correct_answer: It makes the offer more attractive through extra benefits
tasks.explanation_hebrew: sweeten the deal פירושו לשפר את ההצעה ולהפוך אותה למושכת יותר באמצעות כסף והטבות.

tasks.prompt: Compare the financial effects of moving for Brianna and Elena.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להשוות דיור, שכר, חיסכון, מיסים או חשבונות והטבות המעבר.
expected_points: Brianna kept her $107,000 salary
Her housing cost fell from $1,290 rent to $1,100 total ownership costs
Lower taxes, insurance and energy helped her save about $600 monthly
Elena moved from $3,000 rent to a $1,868 mortgage
Elena's salary rose by 22% after changing jobs
Both received $5,000 relocation support
Elena also received a $4,000 quality-of-life package

tasks.prompt: Explain why cash incentives alone may not determine whether a move is successful.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לדון בעלויות ארוכות טווח, עבודה, דיור, משפחה, תחבורה, פעילויות והסתגלות.
expected_points: Long-term housing and living costs matter more than a one-time payment
Remote or local employment must remain viable
Smaller places may offer fewer activities and restaurants
Moving can separate people from family and friends
Children may struggle to settle into new schools
Car dependence may increase
Personal priorities determine whether the trade-off is worthwhile

tasks.prompt: Summarise why small US communities offer relocation schemes and what the two movers experienced.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לסכם באנגלית ירידת אוכלוסייה, משיכת עובדים מרחוק, התוצאות הכלכליות והחסרונות.
expected_points: Some small communities are recovering from decades of population decline
They use cash and lifestyle benefits to attract remote workers
MakeMyMove lists schemes and is paid by participating communities
Brianna and Elena could buy homes and reduce housing costs
Brianna gained about $600 per month
Elena gained salary, security and a shorter commute
Both reported fewer amenities and social or family challenges

tasks.prompt: Write a balanced checklist for someone considering a paid move to a smaller city.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכתוב רשימה באנגלית שמשווה תמריץ חד־פעמי עם עלויות, עבודה, דיור, חינוך, תחבורה וחיי חברה.
expected_points: Check eligibility and conditions of the incentive
Compare total housing costs, taxes, insurance and energy
Confirm employment and salary arrangements
Research schools and healthcare
Consider transport and car dependence
Compare activities, restaurants and social connections
Plan for leaving family and friends
Judge long-term savings rather than only the cash payment
